unit.title: The disordered soul: thémis and PTSD
unit.needIt: This helps you understand why people act out of fear or why they lose trust in others. It explains how a broken sense of order can change how you see the world and your own actions.
unit.why: The lecture looks at how humans need a sense of order to feel safe. When that order is broken by unfairness or violence, it can cause a 'moral injury' that changes how a person sees everything around them.
unit.outcome: Understand how trauma and the loss of social trust affect human behavior.

quiz.q: What does Aristotle say is the special function of a human being?
quiz.why: Aristotle argues that the human good is the activity that expresses reason.
quiz.quote: And the special function of a human being, says Aristotle, is the expression of reason, the soul's activity that expresses reason, in one of the standard translations.

quiz.q: How does Aristotle define virtue in relation to the soul?
quiz.why: Virtue is when your automatic actions match your reflective goals.
quiz.quote: So virtue on Aristotle's picture is being such that instinctive responses fall into line with your reflective commitments.

quiz.q: What is the difference between virtues of thought and virtues of character?
quiz.why: Virtues of character are built through habit, not just by being told facts.
quiz.quote: They are things that you process in the spirited and appetitive parts of your soul as the result of a kind of cultivation of habit.

quiz.why: Virtue is found between a deficiency and an excess.
quiz.quote: The virtues of Aristotle, he says, tend to be ruined by excess and deficiency.

quiz.q: What is a 'moral injury' according to Jonathan Shay?
quiz.why: Moral injury happens when the structure of what is right is destroyed.
quiz.quote: In so doing, injuries are inflicted on the soldiers that are not physical injuries. They are what Shay calls moral injuries.

quiz.q: How does PTSD affect a person's perception of the world?
choices: They see things as more colorful
They see things in the most negative light
quiz.why: Constant alert makes people see every encounter as a potential danger.
quiz.quote: And soldiers who are suffering from post-traumatic stress disorder perceive those things around them through the the heightened attentional mechanisms that come with this hair-trigger action and view them as potential dangers.

decoys.text: Virtue is something you are born with.
decoys.why: Aristotle says virtues of character are acquired through habit, not nature.

decoys.text: Moral injury is only a physical wound.
decoys.why: The lecture defines it as a non-physical injury caused by the betrayal of moral order.

crystal.aha: When we practice the middle way, our habits align with our reason to create a stable life.
